title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Customer360
description: Object represents a consolidated Customer overview. The id of the Customer360 equals the id of the Customer. (TM Forum TMF717 Customer360 5.0.1, OpenAPI component Customer360; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Customer360'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

product.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF717_Customer360Management/blob/v5.0.1/TMF717-Customer360-v5.0.1.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Customer360/properties/product'. List of products of a customer.

id.description: Identifier of the balance within list of the balances (for entities with list)

balanceType.description: Type of the balance : deposit balance, disputed balance, loyalty balance, receivable balance...

AccountRef.description: Account reference. A account may be a party account or a financial account.

AgreementItemRef.description: It's a Agreement item that has been executed previously.

@referredType.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation.

agreementId.description: Unique identifier of a related entity.

agreementItemId.description: Id of an item of a Agreement

AgreementRef.description: Agreement reference. An agreement represents a contract or arrangement, either written or verbal and sometimes enforceable by law, such as a service level agreement or a customer price agreement. An agreement involves a number of other business entities, such as products, services, and resources and/or their specifications.

AgreementSpecificationRef.description: Agreement specification reference. An AgreementSpecification represents a template of an agreement that can be used when establishing partnerships.

description.description: A narrative that explains in detail what the agreement specification is about.

AppointmentRef.description: Refers an appointment, such as a Customer presentation or internal meeting or site visit

description.description: An explanatory text regarding the appointment made with a party

AppointmentStateType.description: Valid values for the lifecycle state of the appointment

Attachment.description: Complements the description of an element (for instance a product) through video, pictures...

name.description: The name of the attachment

description.description: A narrative text describing the content of the attachment

url.description: The URL pointing to the attachment content held in an external system, such as a content management system or document repository. Mutually exclusive with content.

content.description: The actual contents of the attachment object, embedded inline and encoded as base64. Mutually exclusive with url.

attachmentType.description: a business characterization of the purpose of the attachment, for example logo, instructionManual, contractCopy

mimeType.description: A technical characterization of the attachment content format using an IETF Media Type, for example application/pdf or image/png. Note: this property is named mimeType for historical reasons.

AttachmentRef.description: Attachment reference. An attachment complements the description of an element (for instance a product) through video, pictures

AttachmentRefOrValue.description: The polymorphic attributes @type, @schemaLocation & @referredType are related to the Attachment entity and not the AttachmentRefOrValue class itself

BillingAccountRef.description: BillingAccount reference. A BillingAccount is a detailed description of a bill structure.

ratingType.description: Indicates whether the account follows a specific payment option such as prepaid or postpaid

BooleanArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Boolean(s).

value.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Boolean(s).

BooleanCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Boolean.

BusinessPartner.description: When business partner is the BusinessPartner

CalendarPeriod.description: The CalendarPeriod schema represents a period of time within a calendar, defining various attributes such as the applicable day, timezone, hour period, and status. It is designed to capture information about the availability or status of a calendar period, which can be used in scheduling, booking, or resource allocation applications.

timeZone.description: Indication of the timezone applicable to the calendar information in ISO 8601 timezone: either 'Z' for UTC or an offset like +02:00 or -05:30.

hourPeriod.description: Start and end time range in 24-hour HH:mm format.

status.description: Indication of the availability of the calendar period (e.g.: available, booked, etc.)

Characteristic.description: Describes a given characteristic of an object or entity through a name/value pair. This is an abstract base class, the actual value is in one of the strongly-typed subclasses : StringCharacteristic, ObjectCharacteristic, FloatCharacteristic, BooleanCharacteristic, NumberCharacteristic, IntegerCharacteristic, StringArrayCharacteristic, ObjectArrayCharacteristic, BooleanArrayCharacteristic, NumberArrayCharacteristic, IntegerArrayCharacteristic...

name.description: Name of the characteristic

valueType.description: Data type of the value of the characteristic

CharacteristicRelationship.description: Another Characteristic that is related to the current Characteristic;

ContactMedium.description: Indicates the contact medium that could be used to contact the party. This is an abstract base class, the actual value is in one of the strongly-typed subclasses : EmailContactMedium, FaxContactMedium, PhoneContactMedium, GeographicAddressContactMedium, SocialMediaContactMedium...

preferred.description: If true, indicates that is the preferred contact medium

contactType.description: Type of the contact medium to qualify it like pro email / personal email. This is not used to define the contact medium used.

CreditProfile.description: Credit profile for the party (containing credit scoring, ...). By default only the current credit profile is retrieved. It can be used as a list to give the party credit profiles history, the first one in the list will be the current one.

creditProfileDate.description: The date the profile was established

creditRiskRating.description: This is an integer whose value is used to rate the risk

creditScore.description: A measure of a person or organizations creditworthiness calculated on the basis of a combination of factors such as their income and credit history

Customer360AccountVO.description: Acount value object to contain the important information about the accounts of a customer.

accountType.description: A categorization of an account, such as individual, joint, and so forth, whose instances share some of the same characteristics. Note: for flexibility we use a String here but an implementation may use an enumeration with a limited list of valid values.

description.description: Detailed description of the party account

lastUpdate.description: Date of last modification of the account

name.description: Name of the account

state.description: Contains the lifecycle state such as: Active, Closed, Suspended and so on.

Customer360AgreementVO.description: Agreement value object to contain the important information about the agreements of a customer.

agreementType.description: The type of the agreement. For example commercial

engagedParty.description: The parties that sign the agreement and are bound by its terms

name.description: A human-readable name for the agreement

status.description: The current status of the agreement. Typical values are: in process, approved and rejected

Customer360AppointmentVO.description: Appointment value object to contain the important information about the appointments of a customer.

category.description: Business category : intervention for example or to be more precise after SalesIntervention, orderDeliveryIntervention,...

description.description: Short free text describing the appointment

externalId.description: External reference known by the Partner

Customer360CustomerBillVO.description: CustomerBill value object to contain the important information about the bills of a customer.

billNo.description: Bill reference known by the customer or the party and displayed on the bill. Could be different from the id

category.description: Category of the bill produced : normal, duplicate, interim, last, trial customer or credit note for example

Customer360CustomerVO.description: Customer value object to contain the important information about the customer.

name.description: A word, term, or phrase by which the Customer is known and distinguished from other Customers.

status.description: Used to track the lifecycle status of the party role.

Customer360LoyaltyAccountVO.description: LoyaltyAccount value object to contain the important information about the loyalty account of a customer. A LoyaltyAccount corresponds to a set of balances to carry loyalty movement according to different validity period and unit.

accountBalance.description: List of balances for the account, for example loyalty earnings wallet, loyalty banked wallet.

relatedParty.description: List of parties that have some relationship with the account, for example the loyalty program member

Customer360PartyInteractionVO.description: PartyInteraction value object to contain the important information about the party interactions of a customer.

description.description: Description of the interaction

status.description: Status of the interaction (opened, inProgress, completed)

Customer360PaymentMethodVO.description: PaymentMethod value object to contain the important information about the payment methods of a customer.

description.description: The contents of the payment method

isPreferred.description: If the method is the preferred one by the owner. Typically used when querying for the payment methods of a specific customer or account

name.description: Friendly name assigned to the payment method

statusDate.description: The date when the status was set

Customer360ProductOrderVO.description: ProductOrder value object to contain the important information about the product orders of a customer.

category.description: Used to categorize the order from a business perspective that can be useful for the OM system (e.g. "enterprise", "residential", ...)

completionDate.description: Date when the order was completed

description.description: Description of the product order

expectedCompletionDate.description: Expected delivery date amended by the provider

externalId.description: ID given by the consumer and only understandable by him (to facilitate his searches afterwards)

creationDate.description: Date when the order was created

priority.description: A way that can be used by consumers to prioritize orders in OM system (from 0 to 4 : 0 is the highest priority, and 4 the lowest)

Customer360ProductVO.description: Product value object to contain the important information about the products of a customer.

description.description: Is the description of the product. It could be copied from the description of the Product Offering.

name.description: Name of the product. It could be the same as the name of the product offering

Customer360PromotionVO.description: Promotion value object to contain the important information about the promotions of a customer.

description.description: Description of Promotion

name.description: Name of Promotion.

type.description: Type of promotion.The basic type is Award/Discount/Reduction. More types can be extended in future.

Customer360QuoteVO.description: Quote value object to contain the important information about the quotes of a customer.

category.description: Used to categorize the quote from a business perspective that can be useful for the CRM system (e.g. "enterprise", "residential", ...)

creationDate.description: Date and time when the quote was created

description.description: Description of the quote

effectiveQuoteCompletionDate.description: Date when the quote has been completed

expectedFulfillmentStartDate.description: this is the date wished by the requester to have the requested quote item delivered

expectedQuoteCompletionDate.description: This is expected date - from quote supplier - to be able to send back a response for this quote

version.description: Quote version - if the Partner rejected the quote but negotiations still open a new version of the quote is managed

Customer360ServiceProblemVO.description: ServiceProblem value object to contain the important information about the service problems of a customer.

affectedService.description: List of affected services. At least one of affectedResource, affectedService or affectedLocation should be present.

category.description: Classifier for the problem. Settable. For example, this is used for distinguish the category of problem originator in [role].[category] format. Example: serviceProvider.declarer, supplier.originated, system.originated

description.description: Free form text describing the Service Problem

originatingSystem.description: Indicates where the problem was generated

priority.description: An indication varying from 1 (highest) to 10 (lowest) of how important it is for the service provider to correct the Service Problem.

reason.description: Reason, if known, for the service problem that will assist the Service Provider in understanding the underlying cause or contributing factors, enabling more accurate diagnosis and resolution. This can be set to Unknown, otherwise.

status.description: The current status of the service problem. Possible values are Submitted, Rejected, Acknowledged, In Progress [Held, Pending], Resolved, Closed, and Cancelled.

Customer360TroubleTicketVO.description: TroubleTicket value object to contain the important information about the trouble tickets for a customer.

creationDate.description: The date on which the trouble ticket was created

description.description: Description of the trouble or issue

expectedResolutionDate.description: The expected resolution date determined by the trouble ticket system

externalIdentifier.description: Additional identifier coming from an external system

lastUpdate.description: The date and time that the trouble ticked was last updated

name.description: Name of the trouble ticket, typically a short description provided by the user that create the ticket

priority.description: The priority of the trouble ticket and how quickly the issue should be resolved. Example: Critical, High, Medium, Low. The value is set by the ticket management system considering the severity, ticket type etc...

requestedResolutionDate.description: The resolution date requested by the user

severity.description: The severity of the issue. Indicate the implication of the issue on the expected functionality e.g. of a system, application, service etc.. Severity values can be for example : Critical, Major, Minor

statusChangeDate.description: The date and time the status changed.

statusChangeReason.description: The reason for changing the status

ticketType.description: represent a business type of the trouble ticket e.g. incident, complain, request

CustomerBillStateType.description: Recommended Enumeration Type (not formal forced in standard): Valid values for the lifecycle state of the bill: new = 'bill is ready to validate or to sent', validated = 'bill is checked (manual / automatic)', sent = 'bill is sent with the channel defined in the billingaccount', settled = 'bill is payed', partiallySettled = 'bill is partially payed', onHold = 'bill will not be in further processing until open issues connected to the bill are solved'

DayOfWeekType.description: Possible values for the days of the week.

Disability.description: Lack or inadequate strength or ability.

Duration.description: A time interval in a given unit of time

amount.description: Time interval (number of seconds, minutes, hours, etc.)

units.description: Unit of time (seconds, minutes, hours, etc.)

ExternalIdentifier.description: An identification of an entity that is owned by or originates in a software system different from the current system, for example a ProductOrder handed off from a commerce platform into an order handling system. The structure identifies the system itself, the nature of the entity within the system (e.g. class name) and the unique ID of the entity within the system. It is anticipated that multiple external IDs can be held for a single entity, e.g. if the entity passed through multiple systems on the way to the current system. In this case the consumer is expected to sequence the IDs in the array in reverse order of provenance, i.e. most recent system first in the list.

owner.description: Name of the external system that owns the entity.

externalIdentifierType.description: Type of the identification, typically would be the type of the entity within the external system

id.description: identification of the entity within the external system.

name.description: The name for the feature.

isEnabled.description: True if this feature is enabled. Default is true.

isBundle.description: True if this is a feature group. Default is false.

items.description: A feature category which may be assigned to certain groups of features.

featureCharacteristic.description: This is a list of Characteristics for a particular feature.

policyConstraint.description: Reference to manage a list of feature specification policy constraints

attachment.description: Attachments relevant to this Feature, such as documentation

relatedParty.description: Party that may be relevant to this Feature.

relationshipType.description: This is the type of the feature relationship.

name.description: This is the name of the target feature.

FloatCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Float.

GeographicAddress.description: Structured textual way of describing how to find a Property in an urban area (country properties are often defined differently). Note : Address corresponds to SID UrbanPropertyAddress

city.description: City that the address is in

country.description: Country that the address is in

locality.description: An area of defined or undefined boundaries within a local authority or other legislatively defined area, usually rural or semi rural in nature. [ANZLIC-STREET], or a suburb, a bounded locality within a city, town or shire principally of urban character [ANZLICSTREET]

postcode.description: descriptor for a postal delivery area, used to speed and simplify the delivery of mail (also know as zipcode)

stateOrProvince.description: the State or Province that the address is in

streetName.description: Name of the street or other street type

streetNr.description: Number identifying a specific property on a public street. It may be combined with streetNrLast for ranged addresses

streetNrLast.description: Last number in a range of street numbers allocated to a property

streetNrLastSuffix.description: Last street number suffix for a ranged address

streetSuffix.description: A modifier denoting a relative direction

streetType.description: alley, avenue, boulevard, brae, crescent, drive, highway, lane, terrace, parade, place, tarn, way, wharf

countryCode.description: Country codes are short alphabetic or numeric geographical codes (geocodes) developed to represent countries and dependent areas, for use in data processing and communications. Several different systems have been developed to do this. The term country code frequently refers to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or international dialing codes, the E.164 country calling codes.

geographicAddressType.description: Classification of the address, e.g., residential, industrial

geographicAddressRelationship.description: A list of geographic addresses relationships. Represents a relationship between geographic addresses

GeographicAddressRelationship.description: The GeographicAddressRelationship schema represents a relationship between geographic addresses. It defines the structure for storing information about how two geographic addresses are related to each other within a system.

id.description: Unique identifier of the related geographic address. This identifier serves as a reference to uniquely identify the associated geographic address within the system.

name.description: Name of the geographic address. This attribute provides a human-readable name or label for the related geographic address, which can help users identify and differentiate between different addresses.

relationshipType.description: Type of relationship between the geographic addresses. This attribute specifies the nature of the relationship between the related addresses. It provides context for understanding how the addresses are related to each other.

GeographicLocation.description: A GeographicLocation is a pure-virtual super-class to the GeoJSON-aligned geometries of Point (addresses and locations), MultiPoint, LineString (streets, highways and boundaries), MultiLineString and Polygon (countries, provinces, tracts of land). Use the @type attribute to specify which of these is being specified by the geometry attribute.

GeographicLocationRefOrValue.description: The polymorphic attributes @type, @schemaLocation & @referredType are related to the GeographicLocation entity and not the GeographicLocationRefOrValue class itself

GeographicSite.description: A GeographicSite is a managed place, such as a retail store, warehouse or data centre. It will have related responsible parties, a calendar of access times and be described by addresses and/or locations

note.description: Unstructured notes made about this site

capacity.description: Capacities for the site indicating maximum operational thresholds (for example: people, floorspace, racks)

creationDate.description: Date and time when the GeographicSite was created

lastUpdate.description: Date and time when the GeographicSite was last updated

status.description: The condition of the GeographicSite, such as planned, underConstruction, cancelled, active, inactive, former

relatedParty.description: Collection of related roles and parties references (such as site manager, site owner, site operator)

calendar.description: Periods of (for example) access, opening, alarm, unavailability of this site

relatedAddress.description: Collection of related address references (such as delivery-address, office-address)

relatedLocation.description: Collection of related location references (such as retail-complex, service-access)

geographicSiteRelationship.description: This site might have relationships to other sites

contactMedium.description: Contact information for people with responsibility for this site

GeographicSiteFeature.description: Geographic Site Feature captures various site information, ranging from survey data to safety guidelines and hazard information

GeographicSiteRefOrValue.description: The polymorphic attributes @type, @schemaLocation & @referredType are related to the GeographicSite entity and not the GeographicSiteRefOrValue class itself

GeographicSiteRelationship.description: Details of a geographic site relationship

relationshipType.description: Type of relationship between GeographicSites, such as adjacentTo, connectedBy

GeographicSubAddress.description: Representation of a GeographicSubAddress It is used for addressing within a property in an urban area (country properties are often defined differently). It may refer to a building, a building cluster, or a floor of a multistory building.

buildingName.description: allows for buildings that have well-known names

levelNumber.description: used where a level type may be repeated e.g. BASEMENT 1, BASEMENT 2

levelType.description: describes level types within a building

name.description: Name of the subAddress to identify it with a meaningful identification

privateStreetName.description: private streets internal to a property (e.g. a university) may have internal names that are not recorded by the land title office.

privateStreetNumber.description: private streets numbers internal to a private street

subUnit.description: Representation of a SubUnit. It is used for describing subunit within a subAddress e.g. BERTH, FLAT, PIER, SUITE, SHOP, TOWER, UNIT, WHARF.

subAddressType.description: Type of subAddress : it can be a subunit or a private street

GeographicSubAddressUnit.description: Representation of a SubUnit. It is used for describing subunit within a subAddress e.g. BERTH, FLAT, PIER, SUITE, SHOP, TOWER, UNIT, WHARF.

subUnitNumber.description: The discriminator used for the subunit, often just a simple number but may also be a range.

subUnitType.description: The type of subunit e.g.BERTH, FLAT, PIER, SUITE, SHOP, TOWER, UNIT, WHARF, RACK

endHour.description: The end of the hour period, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (e.g., 12:00 for noon, 23:59 for one minute before midnight).

startHour.description: The beginning of the hour period, expressed in 24-hour HH:mm format (e.g., 09:00 for 9 AM, 17:30 for 5:30 PM).

Individual.description: Individual represents a single human being (a man, woman or child). The individual can be a customer, an employee or any other person that the organization needs to store information about.

placeOfBirth.description: Reference to the place where the individual was born

countryOfBirth.description: Country where the individual was born

title.description: Useful for titles (aristocratic, social,...) Pr, Dr, Sir, ...

preferredGivenName.description: Contains the chosen name by which the individual prefers to be addressed. Note: This name may be a name other than a given name, such as a nickname

legalName.description: Legal name or birth name (name one has for official purposes)

name.description: Full name flatten (first, middle, and last names) - this is the name that is expected to be presented in reference data types such as PartyRef, RelatedParty, etc. that refer to Individual

formattedName.description: A fully formatted name in one string with all of its pieces in their proper place and all of the necessary punctuation. Useful for specific contexts (Chinese, Japanese, Korean)

location.description: Temporary current location of the individual (may be used if the individual has approved its sharing)

otherName.description: List of other names by which this individual is known

individualIdentification.description: List of official identifications issued to the individual, such as passport, driving licence, social security number

disability.description: List of disabilities suffered by the individual

languageAbility.description: List of national languages known by the individual

skill.description: List of skills exhibited by the individual

familyName.description: Contains the non-chosen or inherited name. Also known as last name in the Western context

IndividualIdentification.description: Represents our registration of information used as proof of identity by an individual (passport, national identity card, drivers license, social security number, birth certificate)

issuingAuthority.description: Authority which has issued the identifier, such as: social security, town hall

issuingDate.description: Date at which the identifier was issued

identificationType.description: Identification type (passport, national identity card, drivers license, social security number, birth certificate)

IndividualStateType.description: Valid values for the lifecycle state of the individual

IntegerArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Integer(s).

value.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Integer(s).

IntegerCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Integer.

Intent.description: An Intent instance is the formal description of all expectations including requirements, goals, and constraints given to a technical system

description.description: The description of the intent.

isBundle.description: isBundle determines whether an intent represents a single intent (false), or a bundle of intents(true).

priority.description: Can be used by intent owner to prioritize intents in an intent management system

statusChangeDate.description: A date time( DateTime). The date that the entity status changed to the current one

context.description: A string used to give a context to the intent

version.description: A field that identifies the specific version of an instance of an intent.

Organization.description: Organization represents a group of people identified by shared interests or purpose. Examples include business, department and enterprise. Because of the complex nature of many businesses, both organizations and organization units are represented by the same data.

isLegalEntity.description: If value is true, the organization is a legal entity known by a national referential.

isHeadOffice.description: If value is true, the organization is the head office

name.description: Organization name (department name for example)

nameType.description: Type of the name : Co, Inc, Ltd, etc.

otherName.description: List of additional names by which the organization is known

organizationIdentification.description: List of official identifiers given to the organization, for example company number in the registry of companies

organizationChildRelationship.description: List of organizations that are contained within this organization. For example if this organization is the Legal Department, the child organizations might include Claims, Courts, Contracts

tradingName.description: Name that the organization (unit) trades under

OrganizationChildRelationship.description: Child references of an organization in a structure of organizations.

title.description: Use for titles (aristrocatic, social, ...): Pr, Dr, Sir,....

preferredGivenName.description: Contains the chosen name by which the person prefers to be addressed. Note: This name may be a name other than a given name, such as a nickname

familyName.description: Contains the non-chosen or inherited name. Also known as last name in the Western context

legalName.description: Legal name or birth name (name one has for official purposes)

fullName.description: Full name flatten (first, middle, and last names)

formattedName.description: . A fully formatted name in one string with all of its pieces in their proper place and all of the necessary punctuation. Useful for specific contexts (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, etc.)

Party.description: Generic and Abstract Party structure used to define commonalities between sub concepts of Individual and Organization.

externalReference.description: List of identifiers of the Party in an external system, for example when party information is imported from a commerce system

partyCharacteristic.description: List of additional characteristics that a Party can take on.

taxExemptionCertificate.description: List of tax exemptions granted to the party. For example, a war veteran might have partial exemption from state tax and a full exemption from federal tax

creditRating.description: List of credit profiles and scores for the party, typically received from an external credit broker

contactMedium.description: List of means for contacting the party, e.g. mobile phone, email address

PartyCreditProfile.description: An individual might be evaluated for its worthiness and this evaluation might be based on a credit rating given by a credit agency.

creditAgencyType.description: Type of the credit agency giving the score

ratingReference.description: Reference corresponding to the credit rating

ratingScore.description: A measure of a party's creditworthiness calculated on the basis of a combination of factors such as their income and credit history

PartyRole.description: The part played by a party in a given context.

name.description: A word, term, or phrase by which the PartyRole is known and distinguished from other PartyRoles. It's the name of the PartyRole unique entity.

description.description: A description of the PartyRole.

role.description: Role played by the engagedParty in this context. As role is defined by partyRoleSpecification, this role attribute can be used to precise the role defined by partyRoleSpecification, or it can be used to define the role in case there is no partyRoleSpecification.

characteristic.description: Describes the characteristic of a party role.

status.description: Used to track the lifecycle status of the party role.

statusReason.description: A string providing an explanation on the value of the status lifecycle. For instance if the status is Rejected, statusReason will provide the reason for rejection.

PartyRoleRef.description: Party role reference. A party role represents the part played by a party in a given context.

description.description: Is the description of the product. It could be copied from the description of the Product Offering.

orderDate.description: Is the date when the product was ordered

productSerialNumber.description: Is the serial number for the product. This is typically applicable to tangible products e.g. Broadband Router.

TaxDefinition.description: Reference of a tax definition. A tax is levied by an authorized tax jurisdiction. For example, there are many different types of tax (Federal Tax levied by the US Government, State Tax levied by the State of California, City Tax levied by the City of Los Angeles, etc.).

name.description: Tax name.

jurisdictionName.description: Name of the jurisdiction that levies the tax

jurisdictionLevel.description: Level of the jurisdiction that levies the tax

TaxExemptionCertificate.description: A tax exemption certificate represents a tax exemption granted to a party (individual or organization) by a tax jurisdiction which may be a city, state, country,... An exemption has a certificate identifier (received from the jurisdiction that levied the tax) and a validity period. An exemption is per tax types and determines for each type of tax what portion of the tax is exempted (partial by percentage or complete) via the tax definition.

id.description: Identifier of the tax exemption within list of the exemptions

taxDefinition.description: A list of taxes that are covered by the exemption, e.g. City Tax, State Tax. The definition would include the exemption (e.g. for a rate exemption 0% would be a full exemption, 5% could be a partial exemption if the actual rate was 10%).

certificateNumber.description: Identifier of a document that shows proof of exemption from taxes for the taxing jurisdiction

issuingJurisdiction.description: Name of the jurisdiction that issued the exemption

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETF-RFC-3339 format

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETF-RFC-3339 format
